Setting up Coop

Coop can run services alongside your agents.
Choose any this project needs, or press Enter for none.

  postgres
  redis

Services (space-separated, or press Enter for none): postgres redis

✓ Coop project created
  Codex has instructions, skills, and one task queue.
  Formatting checked before every commit: go
  Services for agents to use: postgres, redis

Network access is filtered.
Codex can reach OpenAI.
Other network traffic is blocked until you approve rules allowing it.

Start postgres and redis
  → coop up

Verify the sandbox
  → coop doctor

Start working
  → coop tasks add "Describe your first task"
  → coop loop codex
